changelog:
More control when a channel misbehaves, and decoding fixes that now carry over correctly between versions.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings, Playback has a Hardware decoding switch. Turning it off decodes every channel in software, which can fix a green or garbled picture on some channels at the cost of more battery.
- When a channel has failed with the phone's video hardware, the app remembers to use software for it. That memory now resets properly when you install a new version, so each new version gets a fresh chance to play those channels in hardware.
- Settings, Playback has five reconnect settings: how long to wait for a picture, how long to allow buffering before reconnecting, how long a stream must play smoothly before its retry count resets, how long to ignore start-up hiccups, and how many times to reconnect before stopping.
- The defaults are the values the app already used, so nothing changes unless you change them.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- How the app plays channels you have not changed any settings for.

NOT YET

- A second player the app switches to by itself when the first one cannot play a channel.
